mail.willy.intro.body: Hey, @:^^Heard you have been getting the hang of fishing. Well done!^Something seems a little strange in the waters off the beach lately. Something I have never seen before has found its way in. A few nights ago, I was packing up my fishing gear when I spotted a huge shadow moving just beneath the surface. But by the time I shone my lantern on it, it was gone. If you reel in anything unusual, be sure to bring it by so I can take a look.^^—Willy
mail.willy.intro.title: A Letter from Willy
mail.willy.reward.body: Hey, @:^I told the Anglers Association about that strange octopus you caught. They say they have never recorded a creature like it before.^The reward for discovering a new species is 5000g, and it is all yours!^-Willy
mail.willy.reward.title: A Reward from the Anglers Association
quest.mystery.title: A Shadow in the Sea
quest.inspection.description: You caught a strange octopus. Take it to Willy so he can have a look.
quest.inspection.objective: Bring the strange octopus into the Fish Shop while Willy is there.
quest.mystery.description: Willy spotted an enormous shadow beneath the sea late at night. Try to catch the mysterious creature lurking in the ocean after dark.
quest.mystery.objective: Catch the mysterious creature that appears in the ocean late at night.
dialogue.willy.inspection.0: Hey, @! Let me have a look at what you brought.
dialogue.willy.inspection.1: Hmm... That is one strange-looking octopus. In all my years fishing these waters, I have never seen a big fellow like this!#$b#How interesting! I will tell the Anglers Association about it.#$b#You can keep this odd octopus. Take good care of it in a fish pond and you might get something extra out of it.$h
order.seahares.title: Marine Invaders: Strange Sea Hares
dialogue.demetrius.complete: What? You only started seeing these creatures in the ocean after accepting my request? Haha... Surely that is just a coincidence.
dialogue.demetrius.sample: Thank you for this specimen. Please keep collecting the other varieties.
mail.demetrius.return.body: Hey, @:^^Thank you for helping with the aquatic survey. I have finished recording all six species, and the specimens are in good health.^^I am returning one of each, along with a Large Fish Tank so you can keep observing them.^^As for where they came from... the ocean is full of surprises, is it not?^^—Demetrius
mail.demetrius.return.title: Aquatic Research: Specimens Returned
fish.seahare.konig.description: It looks soft and squishy. So spicy!
fish.seahare.ke.description: It looks soft and squishy. Take a bite... Matcha-flavored... Wait, that is wasabi!
fish.seahare.soap.description: It looks soft and squishy, with a vanilla-chocolate flavor.
fish.seahare.ni.description: It looks soft and squishy, with shorter ears than the other sea hares. Its bitter taste perks you right up.
fish.seahare.ghost.description: It looks soft and squishy, but it might throw punches and kicks inside your stomach.
quest.seahares.objective: Catch all six kinds of sea hare and deliver one of each to Demetrius.
quest.seahares.description: Demetrius would like your help investigating the curious creatures that have recently appeared in the ocean.
mail.demetrius.intro.title: Aquatic Research with Demetrius
mail.demetrius.intro.body: Hey, @:^^I hear you have become quite an accomplished angler. I am conducting a marine survey and could use your help collecting specimens. Some curious creatures have recently appeared in these waters, unlike anything seen here before. Their active hours and preferred weather vary, so if you have some time, try visiting the coast under different conditions.^^—Demetrius
